summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of the new Book Chauffeur wizard at /book-chauffeur. All 22 test scenarios from the review request pass. The multi-step flow (Duration → Trip Details → Vehicle → Confirm), validations, dynamic vehicle cards, AED pricing, airport dropdowns, date/time pickers, booking summary, confirmation screen, navigation from navbar, back button, and mobile responsiveness all work correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Date disabled predicate `d < tomorrow` compares full Date objects. `tomorrow` is set to `new Date(); setDate(+1)` retaining current time. Calendar day cells are at 00:00 so tomorrow's cell is numerically < tomorrow-at-current-time, making tomorrow appear disabled (only day after tomorrow onwards are selectable). Minor UX nit — consider `tomorrow.setHours(0,0,0,0)` so users can book for tomorrow.

BookChauffeurPage.js is ~820 lines in a single file. Consider splitting into step components (DurationStep, TripDetailsStep, VehicleStep, ConfirmStep) and a vehicles constants file for better maintainability.
Booking is entirely client-side — form submission only sets `submitted` state with no backend persistence. Ensure PRD expects this (no API mocked per request).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features of BookChauffeurPage verified working. Key data-testids: book-chauffeur-page, chauffeur-hero, step-indicator, step-duration, step-trip-details, step-vehicle, step-confirm, duration-4h/8h, date-picker-trigger, time-picker-trigger, pickup-type-location/airport, dropoff-type-location/airport, pickup-airport-select, dropoff-airport-select, pickup-location-input, dropoff-location-input, passengers-3/4/6, vehicle-card-{name-kebab}, input-name/email/phone/notes, booking-summary, btn-prev-step/btn-next-step/btn-submit-booking, booking-confirmation, book-another-btn, nav-book-now-btn. Calendar's tomorrow-disabled comparison is slightly off (tomorrow also disabled) — minor UX polish only.
rca of the issue: No issues. One minor UX observation: `tomorrow` timestamp in date-disabled predicate retains the current time, making tomorrow's cell (at 00:00) evaluated as before tomorrow-at-now, so it is disabled. Fix: `tomorrow.setHours(0,0,0,0)` before passing to `disabled` check.
